title: Questions 153-154 refer to the following text-message chain.
passage_1:
Priya Anand (11:05 A.M.)
How are the preparations coming along for our booth at Thursday’s careers fair?

Callum Reid (11:06 A.M.)
Good. I’ve collected the display banners, and our director said the department will cover the cost of the giveaway pens for everyone. We just need to sort out the handouts.

Priya Anand (11:08 A.M.)
I could print and fold them on the office machine and bring them along on the day. Does that sound good?

Callum Reid (11:09 A.M.)
Let’s order them from a print shop. Each of us can put in a small amount of money to cover it.

Priya Anand (11:10 A.M.)
Good idea. That does seem easier.
